data.body: services/review.py + api/review.py. (1) B779270c994: split_diff keeps the newline with a file's header, so a file larger than max_chunk_chars is never sent as a header-only chunk (R1dc7a03312). (2) Bbf41d8f07f: the text git appends after a hunk header's closing @@ (its funcname guess, often a line from ANOTHER block) is stripped before the diff reaches a reviewer (Rc33e00d805). (3) Bd2332f8f2a part 1: a PARTIAL/UNAVAILABLE result names EVERY unreviewed chunk with its cause and its files, and evidence carries them (R26b16478ef); a chunk that ran out of budget (TRUNCATED / did not converge) is re-split once at half max_chunk_chars and the halves reviewed ([[reviewer]].resplit, default true). The --chunk re-review that merges coverage is a separate task (needs cli.py/mcp.py). (4) B338a8bb598: a read timeout after the endpoint accepted the request reads 'did not converge within timeout_s' with the remedy, not 'unreachable: timed out'; a reply cut at max_tokens with text but no STATUS is reported TRUNCATED (finish_reason=length), not off-contract (Raf403f34b3). (5) B9d8bd466c3 part 1: per-chunk progress lines as each chunk settles and a 'still waiting' line while chunks are in flight; the auto-'failed' policy part needs the operator. (6) Bc6ec4fd40d/Bf0cccb8fb1: review renews the caller's lease on the item every lease.heartbeat_s while it waits, on the caller's thread, only if the caller holds it (gate run already does: R247389c7cd). (7) Bbeb0c7542f: [prompts].review_rules (text) is passed as extra_rules; overrides_from passes only template names.
data.title: Review chunks: no header-only chunk, no misleading hunk-header context, every unreviewed chunk named with its files, a budget-exhausted chunk re-split once and labelled 'did not converge', per-chunk progress, the caller's lease renewed while it runs, [prompts].review_rules feeds extra_rules (fixes bugs B779270c994, Bbf41d8f07f, B338a8bb598, Bbeb0c7542f, Bc6ec4fd40d, Bf0cccb8fb1; part of Bd2332f8f2a, B9d8bd466c3)

data.claim: Today api.review records failed whenever an on-contract review has >=1 finding; refuting them leaves a failed->passed flip that reads like a fix. D-failed-critic-not-blocking (operator, 2026-09-30) made 'failed' a non-blocking outcome and says audit the evidence, not the mark -- it does not settle WHEN failed is recorded. Options: (A) keep as is; (B) a new outcome 'findings' (pending triage) that complete refuses until each finding is resolved confirmed/refuted with a probe -- cleanest meaning, but a new outcome in the vocabulary every gate rule, render and complete reads, and it re-opens the 'do not block' decision; (C) keep 'failed', add 'ddflow review triage <id> --gate G --finding N --refuted|--confirmed --probe ...' that records a triage event per finding, and render a gate whose findings are all refuted as 'failed -> triaged: all refuted' so the flip reads as triage. Recommendation: C -- no new outcome, consistent with the decision, and the log says what happened.

data.body: Operator decision needed before any code (research R5d7bf2d721). Today a review with >=1 finding records the gate 'failed' at once; an author who refutes every finding re-records 'passed', and the log reads like a fix happened. D-failed-critic-not-blocking settles that failed does not block complete, not when failed is recorded. Options: (A) keep; (B) new outcome 'findings' pending triage, complete refuses until every finding is resolved -- re-opens 'do not block'; (C, recommended) keep 'failed', add 'ddflow review triage <id> --gate G --finding N --refuted|--confirmed --probe ...' (and MCP) recording a triage event per finding; render a failed gate whose findings are all refuted as 'failed -> triaged: all refuted'. Ask the operator; record the decision; then implement.
data.title: PROPOSAL (needs operator): a review's findings are triaged before the gate reads as failed -- record per-finding triage (refuted/confirmed + probe) instead of a failed->passed flip (bug B9d8bd466c3 part 2)
